description: Units (a top-level entry of core/src, or one package src) that still raise hand-written errors: a raw Error, TypeError or RangeError, or a hand-written JsailsError subclass. Judged by the error-registry gate (KRN-07); eslint/errors.mjs lints every unit not listed here. An entry is removed when its unit is converted to defineErrors registries; KRN-24 requires the ledger empty.
